def _kkt_solve(H: np.ndarray, g: np.ndarray, A: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray, free: np.ndarray):
    n = H.shape[0]
    m = A.shape[0]
    idx = np.flatnonzero(free)
    nf = idx.size
    if nf == 0:
        if m and float(np.max(np.abs(b))) > 0.0:
            return None
        return np.zeros(n), np.zeros(m), idx
    block = np.zeros((nf + m, nf + m), dtype=np.float64)
    block[:nf, :nf] = H[np.ix_(idx, idx)]
    if m:
        Af = A[:, idx]
        block[:nf, nf:] = Af.T
        block[nf:, :nf] = Af
    rhs = np.concatenate([-g[idx], b]) if m else -g[idx]
    solution = _solve_refined(block, rhs)
    if solution is None:
        return None
    x = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.float64)
    x[idx] = solution[:nf]
    return x, solution[nf:], idx
